data.name: Mary's House
data.detailed_description:
Step inside Mary’s House, a place where silence carries secrets and every room hides fragments of a story long buried.

You play as Carter, returning to his childhood home to uncover the truth behind his mother Mary’s slow descent into madness. As you explore, you’ll piece together the fate of a family fractured by grief, obsession, and the darkness Mary invited inside.

Features

  • Atmospheric Storytelling: Uncover Mary’s past through letters, objects, and hidden memories.

  • Exploration-Driven Horror: No combat — the terror comes from what you discover and the dread of what you can’t explain.

  • Immersive Environments: A detailed, haunting house brought to life with high-quality visuals and unsettling sound design.

  • Psychological Fear: Reality bends as Mary’s mind unravels. Experience distorted perspectives and unexpected phenomena.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 (quad-core)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560 (4 GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (6–8 GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

content_descriptors.notes: Mary's House has some depictions of violence & horror throughout the game to give the player a realistic, haunted experience.
